chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far Abu al-Abbas, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Salih ibn Sa'id, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn Harun, that he wrote to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) asking him for an amulet for the winds that afflict children. So he wrote to him in his own handwriting with these two amulets, and Salih claimed that Ibrahim sent them to me in his handwriting.

Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. I testify that there is no god except Allah. I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. There is no god except Allah and there is no Lord for me except Allah. For Him is the Kingdom and for Him is the Praise. There is no associate for Him. Glorious is Allah. Whatever Allah wills occurs, and whatever He does not will, does not occur.

O Allah, O Possessor of Majesty and Honor, Lord of Musa, Isa, and Ibrahim who fulfilled [Your promise], God of Ibrahim, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqoub, and the Tribes. There is no god except You. Glorious are You, along with what You numbered from Your Signs, and by Your Greatness, and by what the Prophets asked You with, and that You are the Lord of the people.

You were before everything and You are after everything. I ask You by Your Name by which You hold the heavens from falling to the earth except by Your Permission, and by Your Perfect Words by which You revive the dead, that You should protect Your servant So-and-So from the evil of what descends from the sky and what ascends to it, and what emerges from the earth and what enters it. And peace be upon the Messengers, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

And he wrote to him also in his own handwriting: In the Name of Allah, and by Allah, and to Allah, and as Allah wills, and I seek refuge in the Might of Allah, and the Compulsion of Allah, and the Power of Allah, and the Kingdom of Allah. This writing is a healing from Allah for So-and-So, son of So-and-So, son of Your servant and son of Your maid, both servants of Allah. May Allah send blessings upon Muhammad and his Progeny.
ai.seo_question: What are the specific amulets recommended by Imam al-Sadiq for protecting children from harmful winds?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) provides two specific amulets (awdha) for protection against winds that afflict children, reflecting the Shia tradition of using written invocations as spiritual remedies. The first amulet combines declarations of oneness and prophethood with a supplication invoking God's names to protect a servant from elemental evils, while the second is a concise formula declaring the writing itself as healing through divine might.

en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Ja’far abu al-‘Abbas has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Salih ibn Sa’id from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn Harun who wrote to abu Ja’iar (a.s.) asking for a supplication for protection of children against bothering gasses: “The Imam wrote in his own hand writing the following supplications for protection and Salih thought that the Imam had sent them to Ibrahim: ‘

Allah is greater than can be described, Allah is greater than can be described, Allah is greater than can be described. I testify that no one deserves to be worshipped except Allah. I testify that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Allah is greater than can be described. Allah is greater than can be described. No one deserves to be worshipped except Allah. No one is my Lord, except Allah, to Him belongs the kingdom, all praise belongs to Him and He has no partner. Allah is free of all defects. As Allah willed it was, whatever He did not will did not come into being.

O Lord, the Possessor of glory and magnanimity. Lord of Moses, Jesus and Ibrahim who fulfilled his duty, Lord of Ibrahim, Isma’il, Ishaq, Ya’qub and the tribes, no one deserves to be worshipped except You. I glorify You by means of Your signs that You have shown, by means of Your greatness, and by means of the facts with which the prophets pleaded before You for help that You are Lord of the people,

that You were before everything and that You will be after everything, I plead before You through Your name with which You hold the skies from falling on earth except by Your permission, through Your perfect words with which You bring the dead to life, grant protection to Your servant so and so against the evil of whatever comes down from the sky and whatever goes up into the sky, whatever comes out of the earth and whatever enters into it, peace be with the messengers, all praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds.’ “

He also wrote in his own handwriting, ‘In the name of Allah, with (the help of) Allah, to Allah, and as Allah wills, I seek protection (from Allah) for him with the majesty of Allah, with the might of Allah, with the power of Allah, with the possession of Allah, this writing is cure from Allah for so and so, son of male and female, two servants of Allah, O Allah, bestow al- Salat (favors) upon Muhammad and his family.’”
